title: Webhooks & event subscriptions
description: Outbound event subscriptions — configure webhook endpoints, inspect delivered events, and manage the dead-letter queue.

subscriptions.title: Webhook subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Endpoints that receive event notifications. Each subscription filters by event type and authenticates with the configured method.
subscriptions.emptyHint: Create a subscription to start receiving webhook events.
subscriptions.confirmDelete: Delete this subscription? This cannot be undone.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.eventTypesHint: Select the event types this subscription receives.
dialog.authValueHint: Bearer token, basic credentials, or header value.
dialog.authHeaderNameHint: Custom header name (only for auth type 'header').
dialog.initialIntervalHint: Retry backoff seed in seconds. 0 = default.
dialog.sinkKindHint: Optional vendor sink profile. None = generic HMAC webhook.
dialog.sinkFormatHint: Wire dialect for the sink. Default = OCSF.
dialog.sinkCredHint: Tower token/key for this sink — sealed at rest, never shown again.
dialog.sinkCredKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the current credential ({{hint}}).
dialog.sinkCredRequired: A credential is required for this sink.

errors.maxAttempts: Max attempts must be 0 or between 1 and 20.
errors.initialInterval: Initial interval must be 0 or between 5 and 3600 seconds.

secret.title: Subscription secret
secret.description: This HMAC signing secret is shown only once. Copy it now — it cannot be retrieved later.

events.title: Captured events
events.description: The event log with sequence cursor. Filter by event type to narrow results.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.description: Delivery state for webhook event dispatches. Filter by subscription, status, or event type.

deadLetters.title: Dead-letter queue
deadLetters.description: Failed deliveries that exhausted all retry attempts. Redeliver individual items or investigate the cause.
deadLetters.emptyHint: Dead letters appear here when deliveries exhaust all retry attempts.

rotateAuthDialog.title: Rotate auth credential — {{name}}
rotateAuthDialog.description: Provide the new credential for this endpoint. It is sealed at rest and never shown again; the card only displays a fingerprint.
rotateAuthDialog.valueHint: Bearer token, basic credentials, or header value — sent once, never echoed back.

replay.title: Replay events — {{name}}
replay.description: Choose the event sequence range to enqueue again.

history.title: Revision history — {{name}}
history.description: Chronological, append-only snapshots of this subscription.
history.scopeCaption: Restore re-applies only the delivery shape — never credentials or the sink profile.
history.selectTwo: Select two revisions to compare their snapshots.
history.restoreDescription: Restore the selected delivery shape for {{name}}?

egress.title: Destination policy
egress.description: Whether this deployment restricts where your event stream may be sent, and what enforcing it would break. The lever is an operator ceremony on the host; this is the state it acts on.
egress.unreadable: The policy status could not be read.

compat.title: Compatibility
compat.notIntact: The compatibility record is no longer intact: it looks complete but describes a set that has lost members. Do not plan an actuation against it.
compat.notServed: Not served at your permission level.

report.title: What enforcing would break
report.description: The destinations this tenant keeps only because the deployment predates the control.
report.unreadable: The compatibility report could not be read.
report.notSeeded: The compatibility record was never drawn, so this report describes nothing.
